Chandigarh to Develop First 'Green Market' with Extensive Tree Plantation

Chandigarh is set to establish its first 'Green Market' following an initiative to plant 2,500 saplings. The campaign began with the planting of 500 trees. This project aims to transform the appearance of the market area.
